thread:
elaine: quick check — Orchard (enterprise) onboarding requires a per-customer feature flag + contract gating. We need an allowlist so only Orchard gets UI_v2, with a kill-switch and audit trail. Who can provision the flag and wire the contract entitlement check?

sam: I can create the flag in the control plane. do we need a hard deny path in the runtime for emergencies or is toggling the control plane sufficient?

jordan: control plane toggle is fine for normal ops but we should add an ops-level kill switch (on/off via runtime env + emergency route that bypasses cache). I can own the runtime change.

elaine: thanks — Jordan, can you add a small fallback so requests get routed to UI_v1 when the kill-switch flips? we need zero downtime.

jordan: yep — plan: 1) feature flag per_org: "per_customer_ui_v2" 2) allowlist entry for org_id=orchard-42 3) canary: 5% traffic for orchard on web only 4) runtime kill-switch env var REDWOOD_ORCHARD_UI_V2=false that immediately forces ui_v1. will test locally.

maya: pinging product/legal — contract requires that Orchard sees UI_v2 only if addendum signed. Also need audit logs for enable/disable with actor and timestamp. ops-bot can we get retention >90 days for these events?

ops-bot: received request — creating audit retention ticket RD-1147 and enabling org-scoped audit logs for orchard-42 (ETA 2 working days).

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321 — adds control-plane flag + allowlist UI, and a small API to map contract entitlements -> flag grant. cc @elaine for acceptance criteria.

elaine: skimmed PR — looks good. two asks: add unit test for entitlement mapping + add a config var to limit canary percent at runtime.

alex: I can review the PR tomorrow morning. quick note: we should document rollback playbook in /runbooks/feature-flags.md and add a checklist for enterprise toggles (billing, support-notify, SLA).

jordan: added a tiny middleware that forces fallback if env var set, and a canary-percent config. test plan: run e2e with orchard staging org, flip kill-switch, confirm no errors and sessions migrate to UI_v1.

elaine: thanks. next steps: Sam finish control-plane UI + tenant allowlist (PR), Jordan merge runtime kill-switch, Ops will enable audit retention and create the ticket for preserving logs. Alex will review PR. I'll coordinate with legal to confirm addendum signed, then we flip orchard to canary 5%.

maya: when you flip, please open a support note and add a temporary SLA exception in case of regressions. I'll notify account team. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued for platform/main #4321 -> staging at 1759010055.

alex: got it — review scheduled for 08:30 PT. I'll call out any required changes.

elaine: perfect. tagging this thread for visibility. if anyone wants to be assigned: Sam (control plane), Jordan (runtime), Ops (audit) — please update ticket RD-1147 with progress.

sam: starting work now. will update with a screenshot when UI exists in staging.

jordan: running local smoke now, will push integration when PR approved.

elaine: thanks everyone — closing the async check-in, will post a final status update here after canary flip.
